propositions: The production review-bot must be cut over from direct Anthropic API to Bedrock inference profiles to dogfood the client path and surface provider-specific failures before clients encounter them

Per-pass model routing (frontier=opus, standard/trivial=sonnet) must be preserved through the cutover via independent class-slot environment variables rather than a single scalar knob to prevent silent capability regressions
The cutover is additive and reversible: setting three env var slots enables Bedrock; deleting them and recreating the container restores the Anthropic baseline with the retained credential
No cross-provider fallback exists post-cutover; transient Bedrock faults are handled by botocore stock client defaults, not by rebar-configured retry envelopes, and the gap is tracked separately
The ordering criterion mandates the kill switch, safety-net alarm, and in-container provider import verification BEFORE the model-class flip lands in production to prevent taking the gate down
Live end-to-end validation on production changes must confirm every call routes to bedrock inference profiles, zero direct-Anthropic calls, and comparable findings pre/post-cutover
